basis: April 19, 2023 is the earliest qualifying disclosure I could verify. Lam guided consolidated U.S. GAAP revenue for fiscal Q4, ending June 25, 2023, to $3.1 billion ± $300 million. The $3.4 billion high end was below $4,403,776,300, or 95% of the prior-year quarter’s $4,635,554,000. The onset date remains null because I could verify that Lam’s CFO spoke publicly on March 7 but could not verify his full remarks about the June quarter.

coverage.detail: January 25 earnings release. The $3.8 billion ± $300 million U.S. GAAP revenue outlook applied to the quarter ending March 26, 2023. The separate calendar-year discussion concerned wafer fabrication equipment spending.

January 25 earnings call, transcript of management’s remarks. Asked about the June quarter, CFO Doug Bettinger said he would give June guidance on the next earnings call. The suggested trough revenue figures came from an analyst.

Lam’s pre-April release archive identifies the February 9 and 21 announcements as board and executive appointments, February 23 as a conference notice, and March 30 as the scheduling notice for April earnings. I found no June-quarter revenue range in these announcements.

March 7 Morgan Stanley conference. Lam’s event page dates the CFO’s public appearance and links the webcast. The replay could not be retrieved, and I could not verify a complete transcript. This leaves a specific gap between the January and April earnings calls.

April 19 earnings release. Although the headline identifies March results, the Outlook table explicitly identifies June 25, 2023 as the quarter end and gives a U.S. GAAP revenue range of $2.8 billion to $3.4 billion.
Lam’s April 19 earnings presentation confirms the same June-quarter range in the appendix’s U.S. GAAP revenue row, with zero revenue adjustment.

Lam’s event archive lists intervening investor conferences on May 22, May 31 and June 6. Each followed the qualifying April release. The search of intervening releases and filings found no separate preliminary June results.
July 5 notice scheduled the results call for July 26 and supplied webcast details. It gave no revenue figure.

July 26 actuals. The condensed consolidated statements of operations report $3,207,257,000 for the three months ended June 25, 2023 and $4,635,554,000 for the three months ended June 26, 2022 on the same revenue line. The year-over-year decline was 30.81%.

publication_date_evidence: Lam’s qualifying release is datelined April 19, 2023 and marked for immediate release. EDGAR records acceptance of the 8-K containing that exhibit on April 19 at 16:14:28. This verifies the April publication date. [SEC filing index](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/707549/000070754923000077/0000707549-23-000077-index.htm)
